data.title: 胡桃 · 飞檐屋顶夕阳赋诗
data.description: 【胡桃 · 飞檐屋顶夕阳赋诗】黄昏时分的璃月港，万家灯火如星河般逐渐点亮。胡桃盘腿坐在绯云坡古建飞檐的琉璃瓦屋顶上，双手托着脸颊俯瞰繁华港口与绯红晚霞，摇头晃脑地即兴吟诵着大作打油诗——「大太阳落山红霞飞，小胡桃屋顶看落晖！怎么样？本堂主这首诗是不是极有文采？」
data.location: 璃月港绯云坡古建飞檐屋顶
data.action: 盘腿坐在琉璃瓦屋脊上，双手托腮俯瞰万家灯火与绯红夕阳，神情灵动惬意
data.lighting: 壮丽绚烂的绯红金黄晚霞与城市初升暖灯
data.camera: full-body shot, high angle, harbor behind the seated figure
data.promptProse: Above Liyue Harbor, Hu Tao sits cross-legged on a broad tiled ridge, elbows on knees and both cheeks cupped as her parted lips suggest an improvised verse. The high full-body view follows roof tiles down toward the harbor's first lanterns. Crimson sunset lights her twintail tips and curved tile edges; the coat folds beneath her elbows stay dark while warm city lights punctuate the distance.
